_comment: Inputs of bin/mythos-verify-matrix.js. Every exclusion names its reason class and the evidence that it is external; a suite failing for any OTHER assertion is a FAIL. Reason classes: host_scoped (asserts a fact of the VPS host), external_db (needs a PostgreSQL the VPS provides), missing_deps (npm deps not installed on this host), browser_only (runs in a browser console / needs a DOM), deliberate_target (a fixture that fails by design, used by E2E runs), load_sensitive (green standalone, timing under sweep load).
